title: Tampa Terrors Spirits & Spirits Haunted Pub Crawl
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for an unforgettable experience with our Tampa Boos and Booze haunted pub crawl, where you can explore the spooky side of Tampa while enjoying some drinks along the way.

During the tour, you will have the opportunity to visit four of Tampa's most beloved bars, as well as some haunted locations that will send chills down your spine.

With stops at iconic spots like The Hub Bar, Taps, and The Anchor Tavern, you'll get to enjoy a variety of drinks while listening to eerie stories about the haunted history of these locations. The duration of the tour is 2 hours, during which you will have the chance to immerse yourself in the rich history of Tampa and its haunted past.

While the drinks are not included in the tour package, this gives you the freedom to choose your own beverages, whether you prefer cocktails or beers. So come along and join us for a night of spooky fun and delicious drinks in Tampa!
